full_judgment: 3. The case of the plaintiff-opposite party Nos. 1-3, in short, was that an area of 1.01 acres of C.S. plot No. 195 appertaining to khewat No.I 92 originally belonged to Faizuddin in -/2/- annas share, Hachenuddin in -/4/-share, Maju Bibi in, /4/- annas share, Wahed in -2/- annas share and Tarapuddin in remaining -/4/-annas share. Tarapuddin died leaving 3 daughters viz, Amiron, Maiman and Rahimjan. Maiman and Rahimjan sold their shares to Hachenuddin by kabala, dated 3rd Ashar 1321 B.S. Amirjan sold her share to Hashem Ali and Tazem Ali by kabala. dated 29th Magh 1322 B.S. Hashem Ali and Tazem sold the same to Hachenuddin by kabala, dated 30th Sraban 1327 B.S. The share of Wahed developed upon Faizuddin by way of inheritance. Hachenuddin married Khatejan. Faizuddin died leaving behind 4 sons, viz, Kadam Ali, Rahman Ali, Karam Ali and Yakub Ali. Thus Hachenuddin got 8 annas share, Kadam Ali (defendant No.3) got -/1/- annas share, Nowab Ali got -/2/- annas share and Khatejan got -/2/- annas share. During the R.S. operation the aforesaid shares were correctly recorded. Hachenuddin and Khatejan died leaving one son, Kashem Ali and one daughter, plaintiff No. 3 Kashem Ali died leaving sister plaintiff No.3 and 2 wives, plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2, Kadam Ali died leaving 2 sons, defendant Nos. 5 and 6, 3 daughters, defendant Nos 7,8 and 9 and widow defendent No. 15, Nawab Ali died leaving 1 widow, 4 sons and 1 daughter, defendant Nos. 10-12 and 22-24. Thus the plaintiffs got -/10/- annas share in the 'Ka' schedule property and have been possessing the same.
